name: Chicago Traffic Tracker - Historical Congestion Estimates by Segment - 2018-2023

Metadata.Time Period: 2/28/2018 - 9/8/2023, with occasional gaps due to system maintenance and other temporary technical issues.

columns.name: SEGMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique arbitrary number to represent each segment.

columns.name: SPEED
columns.description: Estimated traffic speed in miles per hour. A value of -1 means no estimate is available.

columns.name: STREET
columns.description: Street name of the traffic segment.

columns.name: DIRECTION
columns.description: Traffic flow direction for the segment.

columns.name: FROM_STREET
columns.description: Start street for the segment in the direction of traffic flow.

columns.name: TO_STREET
columns.description: End street for the segment in the direction of traffic flow.

columns.name: LENGTH
columns.description: Length of the segment in miles.

columns.name: STREET_HEADING
columns.description: The position of the segment in the address grid. North, South, East, or West of State and Madison.

columns.name: BUS_COUNT
columns.description: Number of buses providing a GPS feed used to estimate congestion.

columns.name: MESSAGE_COUNT
columns.description: Number of GPS probes received(or used) for estimating the speed for that segment.

columns.name: HOUR
columns.description: Hour of the day.

columns.name: DAY_OF_WEEK
columns.description: Day of the week. Sunday = 1

columns.name: MONTH
columns.description: Month of the year.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: A unique identifier for each record in the dataset.

columns.name: START_LATITUDE
columns.description: Latitude of the start of the segment.

columns.name: START_LONGITUDE
columns.description: Longitude of the start of the segment.

columns.name: END_LATITUDE
columns.description: Latitude of the end of the segment.

columns.name: END_LONGITUDE
columns.description: Longitude of the end of the segment.

columns.name: START_LOCATION
columns.description: Location of the start of the segment.

columns.name: END_LOCATION
columns.description: Location of the end of the segment.
